decisive_items: 2 heterozygous mutations in exon 2 of the CDSN gene
Complete separation of the stratum corneum
Clean split just above the stratum granulosum
response.rationale: The genetic finding is diagnostic and specifically matches the label of CDSN-related peeling skin disease. The biopsy shows the expected subcorneal separation with mild psoriasiform hyperplasia, supporting the same diagnosis over generic or acral forms.

rejected.why: Acral peeling skin syndrome is not supported; the CDSN mutation is present, and the lesions are not predominantly acral.
Peeling skin syndrome type B overlaps with the CDSN-positive disease, but R4 more directly names the confirmed genetic cause.
Peeling skin syndrome is too broad and does not capture the specific CDSN mutation that defines the disease.
